simple.meaning: עֵנָב (ʻênâb) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a grape.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 40:10. The surrounding context includes land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֵנָב (H6025) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: עֵנָב (ʻênâb) / H6025 is traced through Genesis 40:10, Genesis 40:11, Genesis 49:11, Leviticus 25:5 with generated occurrence evidence.
